title: Close nested test-request association decoding before custody activation
outcome: Captured test-request associations reject unsupported nested binding/root fields while retaining the agreed shared Engram input-use wire representation.
acceptance: Behavioral custody-decoding tests reject unknown nested work-binding or verification-root fields before the association can be trusted or persisted.
The agreed shared use representation remains explicit and unchanged: committed_input with expected_commit and purpose, or authorized_test_ref with ref_name, expected_tree and landing_gate purpose.
